messages:
Ana (partnerships): Quick sync: NovaEdge wants a joint perf/W bench for A100X + Redwood. Need measurement rig, kernel/driver branch, telemetry schema, marketplace blurb, and embargo plan. Short plan below.

Devon (eng-runtime): Propose models: rw-gpt-lite + rw-30b-shard. Configs: seq=2048, batch 1/4/16, q8_0/q4_0. Branch: redwood/tune/a100x-novaedge. Will push today.

Ravi (perf): Metrics: tokens/sec, p50/p95, power (1s PDU), tokens/J, temps. Protocol: 3 repeats, cold + warmed (1k) + 20m steady. Need docker sha, git commit, BIOS/firmware versions.

Linh (NovaEdge): Lab runs OK. We'll capture PDU + IPMI + neon-power traces. Note thermal gating after ~45m on some 2U configs; will annotate. Upload to s3://redwood-partners/partners/novaedge-a100x/.

Maya (pressops): Embargo: legal + artifact signoff (2bd) then Tue announce. We need 1-page methods and a marketplace blurb.

benchbot: Reminder: upload bench.json, power.csv, docker sha to s3 by 1748113600.

Ana (partnerships): Actions: Devon push branch + blurb (24h), Linh run & upload (4bd), Ravi analysis + 1p note (3bd), Maya PR skeleton (3bd). React :thumbsup: or :eyes:.

Devon (eng-runtime): :thumbsup: pushing now.

Ravi (perf): :eyes: might need +1 day if variance >6%.

Linh (NovaEdge): :thumbsup: lab run tomorrow morning (PT).
